Apple Scab Leaf.description: A fungal disease that commonly affects apple leaves and can cause dark lesions.

Affected leaves may yellow or fall prematurely
recommended_actions: Improve air circulation around the plant
Use appropriate fungicide only according to local agricultural guidance
